notes: The distance selection is calculated before any Qwen extraction, and excludes evaluation descriptions.
Only 2 independent evaluation facts per concept; the ROC-AUC is low resolution and exploratory.
Descriptions require independent human validation of concept identity and semantic non-overlap.
AUC is pairwise relative decodability, not absolute concept activation.
Candidate selection uses evaluation results; confirm shortlisted concepts on fresh text before use.
Semantic-distance bands reflect within-category rank rather than calibrated absolute distance.
Shuffle has only 20 exhaustive label splits; do not treat as a high-powered statistical test.
